title: Thousands of Nvidia Staff Sign Petition to Bring Back Huang
summary: A petition urging Nvidia’s board to reinstate Jensen Huang passed 100,000 signatures Saturday, including 5,248 people who said they are current Nvidia employees. Signers include Elon Musk, Epic Games’ Tim Sweeney and Y Combinator’s Garry Tan. Huang resigned Nov. 12 following reports of an affair ...
